S1.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
S1.answer:
- **Get Clássica:** focused on faster payments and receipt printing (3G chip, Wi-Fi, paper roll). It's free at R$ 10,000/month in sales per machine, otherwise R$ 79.90/month. 
- **Get Smart:** focused on full management, integrating order and payment, with a 3G chip plus a free data plan and Wi-Fi. It's free at R$ 60,000/month in sales per machine, otherwise R$ 129.90/month. 
- Both accept tap payments and Pix via QR Code.
- Sources: https://www.santander.com.br/blog/seus-negocios/solucoes-getnet/ and https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/termos_e_condicoes_aluguel.pdf

S4.message: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?
S4.answer:
Yes. To sell with Pix on Get Tap, you must enable the feature and link a bank account in the Getnet Brasil app. Go to "Serviços" > "Venda com Pix" > "Habilitar", then choose the bank and follow the on-screen steps to link the account that will receive the Pix payments.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix-no-get-tap-mais-agilidade-e-eficiencia-das-vendas/

S5.answer:
Your terminal (GS-77A1) is offline. It was last seen online on 2026-11-13 at 22:49. It's on Wi-Fi with a weak signal, which is the most likely cause of the drop. Battery is at 42%, and the firmware (4.2.1) is out of date, since 4.3.0 is available.

Steps depend on your model:

- **Get Clássica:** Tap Wi-Fi (or Suporte), choose "Habilitar Wi-Fi", then "Procurar Redes". Select your network and enter the password if needed. [Manual](https://sitehml.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/Manul_GetClassica.pdf)

If it still won't connect, I can open a ticket for our human team to look at the terminal.

S6.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
S6.answer:
Receivables advance lets you receive credit card sales (lump-sum or installments) before the original scheduled date, in exchange for a fee. It is not a loan, since no new debt is created. It is an advance of money that is already yours. (https://site.getnet.com.br/quando-vale-a-pena-antecipar-as-suas-vendas-no-cartao/)

In the Getnet Brasil app, you can check available receivables, simulate the advance, and see the net amount before confirming. (https://site.getnet.com.br/quando-vale-a-pena-antecipar-as-suas-vendas-no-cartao/)

On the Get Smart terminal: Payment > Advance > merchant password > select card brand > consult/simulate > "Antecipar" > enter the advance code > the terminal confirms and prints a receipt. (https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Manul-GetSmart.pdf)

S9.message: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
S9.answer:
With Crediário Getnet you can split a sale into up to 48 installments. The maximum number of installments depends on the customer's issuing bank (e.g., Santander up to 48x, others up to 24x), and it's subject to change. The customer also needs enough available credit card limit to cover the full purchase amount.

Sources:
- https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Folder_Credirio.pdf

S10.message: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
S10.answer:
Yes. Getnet's Payment Link lets you send a customizable link to customers via WhatsApp, SMS, email, or social networks, and they pay by credit card, debit, or Pix (no card machine or online store needed).
